_about: Verification pass, 4 Nov 2026. Documents read in the DOJ release text (EFTA numbers link to justice.gov) and checked against news reports. Status upgrades, new documented ties, and five private individuals held back from the published map.

nodes.name: Plan D, LLC
nodes.note: US Virgin Islands company; Epstein signed as its sole member. Listed as the holder of the Gulfstream G550 N212JE, and the borrower of $30.5M from Leon Black's BV70 LLC in 2017.

nodes.name: BV70 LLC
nodes.note: New York company owned by Leon Black, addressed care of Elysium Management. Lent Epstein's Plan D $30.5M in 2017 (Dechert review for Apollo, 2021); reported as the route for Black's $10M to Gratitude America.

nodes.name: Gulfstream G550 N212JE
nodes.note: Aircraft listed against Plan D, LLC in Epstein's own aircraft list in the release.

nodes.name: Boeing 727 N908JE
nodes.note: Owned by JEGE, Inc., per a 2006 FBI interview with one of Epstein's pilots; seats up to 26.

nodes.name: Gulfstream N909JE
nodes.note: Owned and operated by Hyperion Air, Inc., per the same 2006 FBI interview; seats up to 12. The pilot said Epstein kept a separate company for each plane for liability reasons.

nodes.name: Stacey Plaskett
nodes.note: Delegate to Congress for the US Virgin Islands. Texted with Epstein during a February 2019 House hearing; a House censure resolution over it failed in November 2025. Received campaign donations from Epstein's accountants (reported). Not accused of a crime.

nodes.name: William Barr
nodes.note: US Attorney General 2019–2020; in August 2019 said there were 'serious irregularities' at the jail where Epstein died. Son of Donald Barr, the Dalton headmaster. Nothing in the record ties him to the Dalton hire; the family tie is shown only so the two are not confused.

nodes.name: White House tour, 27 Dec 2015
nodes.note: Woody Allen, Soon-Yi Previn and Kathryn Ruemmler visited on 27 Dec 2015 after Epstein asked Ruemmler in May 2015 to show them the White House (NBC, from released emails and White House visitor records).

node_notes.bella_klein: Assistant Controller at HBRK Associates, Richard Kahn's accounting firm, and an accountant there since November 1999, per a 2019 TD Bank suspicious-activity report in the release (a bank report, not a finding). Listed as a contact for HBRK's accounts. Not accused of a crime. Email counts come from a secondary research export and are not checked.
node_notes.hbrk: HBRK Associates Inc., 575 Lexington Avenue, New York: Richard Kahn's accounting firm. Wires from Epstein, Southern Trust, Southern Financial and Darren K. Indyke PLLC accounts were addressed 'c/o HBRK Associates' (TD Bank SAR, 2019). It described itself to the bank as serving ultra-high-net-worth clients other than Epstein.
